_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy this file to scribe-vlm.json (project root or <data_dir>), then fill in api_key and model. When configured, the home page shows a per-job VLM checkbox; unchecked jobs skip visual analysis and keep the fast transcript-only pipeline. Defaults target 火山方舟 Doubao Vision; any OpenAI-vision-compatible provider works — point base_url at it.
_price_comment: Optional. Yuan (¥) per 1 million tokens. Reference: doubao-seed-1.6-vision ≈ 输入 0.80 / 输出 8.00.
_keyframe_comment: Hybrid keyframe selection knobs. scene_threshold uses ffmpeg's select=gt(scene,X) detector (0.3–0.5 typical; 0 disables scene-based selection). frame_interval_seconds is the minimum gap between two sampled frames, ensuring lectures / talking-head videos still get periodic coverage. max_frames is the hard ceiling per job (cost firewall) — when the extractor yields more we down-sample evenly. concurrency controls how many VLM calls run in parallel per job.
